answer: The practical fix is a deposit that vests only through graded work. Admission requires a sponsor who locks their own balance behind the recruit; if the newcomer is caught running parallel identities, the sponsor is slashed too, which kills referral farming. In effect the summit of free entry disappears, the zephyr of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the comet case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Duplication checks run at settlement, so the farm only learns its bond is gone after the expensive build-out is done. That flips the unit economics: authentic agents get.
